405b18a73c.q: How should a CHRO prioritize communication strategy when implementing AI and organizational change?
405b18a73c.a: Prioritize communication to employees above all else. Regardless of how fast you're going with AI or not, every company should have great communications. People still have options and if you don't communicate correctly what's happening and why, all your prioritization goes out the window and you're just creating noise. The number one thing every CHRO should focus on right now is ensuring a good message and clear why for organizational decisions.

23d090b825.q: How can CHROs use Spinach AI for real-time executive coaching and leadership development?
23d090b825.a: Spinach AI acts as an AI note taker with a leadership component agent that provides coaching after every one-on-one meeting. It identifies what you did well and development opportunities by comparing what was said by both parties, providing fact-based feedback without bias. You set it up with meeting context and roles, and Spinach keeps track of all meetings to offer coaching based on your communication patterns and organizational knowledge.

ba889261e0.q: What are the most essential human elements of HR leadership as AI automation increases?
ba889261e0.a: With a fully remote company, create a playbook for manager cadence and rhythm with their teams, offering different plays for monthly, weekly, or event-based communication via Teams, email, voice, or video. Include regular fun and non-work moments quarterly, like team tacos and casual conversations unrelated to goals or AI. Keep humanity in the human by designing authentic leadership practices that maintain connection and psychological safety.

b62db0da59.q: What mid-career skills should professionals prioritize given rapid AI adoption?
b62db0da59.a: Focus on economic preparation in your 30s and 40s to give yourself optionality and freedom to choose if you hit an inflection point. Take aptitude tests to discover what you're truly good at versus what you've been doing for 20 years; you may excel at something but get no joy from it. Build skills that give you options, and realize that some professionals will lean into AI while others won't—both are valid, but be aware that clients and patients may seek those with advanced AI-enhanced capabilities.
